post.description: One text turn. The fastest way to exercise the dialogue during a build.
Audio in, audio out. Shared by the browser demo and any telephony webhook.

delete.description:
Clear a caller's memory.

Needed for demos and re-testing, and it is also the honest answer to
"delete what you know about me" for a service holding income and caste.

BenefitDetailOut.description: Public benefit details with enough provenance to make trust inspectable.

CoverageOut.title: CoverageOut
CoverageOut.description:
Benefit counts per state and domain.

Useful in the demo for showing honestly how much data is loaded, rather
than implying nationwide coverage the pipeline has not produced yet.

Intent.title: Intent
Intent.description:
What the caller wants on this turn.

Separate from `Domain` because several intents are conversational rather
than a request for benefits.

MatchSummary.description: A match flattened for the API, without the full criterion trace.

TurnRequest.title: TurnRequest
TurnRequest.description: A text-mode turn. The voice endpoint builds this after transcription.

VerificationStatus.title: VerificationStatus
VerificationStatus.description:
How much human review a benefit row has received.

These values are deliberately data rather than Python branches: a new
source row can move through the review lifecycle without changing matcher
logic. Only ``human_verified`` rows are production-ready.
